title: Synthesis, Antioxidant, Molecular Docking and DNA Interaction Studies of Metal-Based Imine Derivatives.
authors: Ibrahim, Mohammad; Nabi, Hazrat Un; Muhammad, Niaz; Ikram, Muhammad; Khan, Momin; Ibrahim, Musadiq; AlAsmari, Abdullah F; Alharbi, Metab; Alshammari, Abdulrahman
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成金属席夫碱配合物并实验测定其DNA结合常数，辅以分子对接验证，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作与对接方法，但对象为小分子金属配合物而非TF-DNA体系，且缺乏AI/物理模拟深度建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Currently, numerous ongoing studies are investigating the interaction of free radicals with biological systems, such as lipids, DNA and protein. In the present work, synthesis, characterization, antioxidant, DNA binding and molecular docking studies of Schiff base ligand and its Ni(II), Co(II), Cu(II) and Zn(II) were evaluated. The metal complexes have shown significant dose-dependent antioxidant activities higher than those of the free ligand but lesser than those of the standard antioxidant, ascorbic acid. The DNA binding constants (K(b)) were found in the order Zn(pimp)(2) 9.118 x 10(5) M(-1) > H-pimp 3.487 x 10(5) M(-1) > Co(pimp)(2) 3.090 x 10(5) M(-1) > Ni(pimp)(2) 1.858 x 10(5) M(-1) > Cu(pimp)(2) 1.367 x 10(5) M(-1). Binding constants (K(b)) values calculated from the molecular docking analysis were found to be in close agreement with the experimental results. The obtained results indicate the importance of synthesis complexes as a source of synthetic antioxidants and anticancer drugs.
abstract_zh: 目前，大量正在进行的研究正在探讨自由基与生物系统（如脂质、DNA和蛋白质）之间的相互作用。在本工作中，对席夫碱配体及其Ni(II)、Co(II)、Cu(II)和Zn(II)配合物的合成、表征、抗氧化活性、DNA结合及分子对接研究进行了评估。金属配合物显示出显著的剂量依赖性抗氧化活性，其活性高于游离配体，但低于标准抗氧化剂抗坏血酸。DNA结合常数（K(b)）的顺序为：Zn(pimp)2 9.118 x 10(5) M(-1) > H-pimp 3.487 x 10(5) M(-1) > Co(pimp)2 3.090 x 10(5) M(-1) > Ni(pimp)2 1.858 x 10(5) M(-1) > Cu(pimp)2 1.367 x 10(5) M(-1)。从分子对接分析计算得到的结合常数（K(b)）值与实验结果高度一致。所得结果表明，合成配合物作为合成抗氧化剂和抗癌药物来源的重要性。
